SSC Delhi Police HC Ministerial Physical Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the physical admit card for the post of Head Constable Ministerial on the official website of SSC. This recruitment was released for 456 posts. Applications for the Delhi Police Head Constable Ministerial Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 29, 2025, to October 20, 2025. The CBT examination was held on 07-12 January 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their SSC Delhi Police Constable Ministerial Physical Admit Card 2026 from the link given below..

  • Application Start Date : 29 September 2025
  • Last Date : 20 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 October 2025
  • Online Correction Date : 05-07 November 2025
  • Exam Date : 07-12 January 2026
  • Self Slot Selection : 05 December 2025 to 05 January 2025
  • Exam City Details : 04 January 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Answer Key : 05 February 2026
  • Result : 05 June 2026
  • Final Answer Key / Marks : 22 June 2026
  • Additional Result : 25 June 2026
  • PE & MT Date : 02-03 September 2026
  • PE & MT Date : 22 August 2026
  • Physical Exam Date : 03-05 October 2026
  • Physical Admit Card : 17 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-

  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
